▲ SPAIN: EVACUATION OPS BEGIN 11 MAY — CORDONED ZONE, CHARTER REPATRIATION FLIGHTS
▲ UK: 2 CONFIRMED + 1 SUSPECTED (TRISTAN DA CUNHA) — RETURNING BRITS: 45-DAY ISOLATION
► WHO/SKY NEWS: UP TO 6 CONFIRMED · 9 SUSPECTED · 3 DEATHS — 15 COUNTRIES AFFECTED
► BRITISH SHIP DOCTOR (MARTIN ANSTEE, 56) EVACUATED TO NETHERLANDS — CONDITION IMPROVING

sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Dutch-flagged polar vessel departed Cape Verde 06 May at 19:15 local; expected off Tenerife 09 May. Will NOT dock — Canary Islands president confirmed offshore anchor with tender-boat evacuation. 140+ passengers/crew from 23 nationalities in cabin isolation; all currently asymptomatic. Three specialist doctors aboard. One body still on board. Evacuation operations begin 11 May per Spanish interior ministry.

sites.name: USHUAIA
sites.desc: Suspected source. Argentine health ministry confirmed zero hantavirus cases in Ushuaia/Tierra del Fuego since mandatory notification began 1996. Investigation now pivoting to Neuquén (Sur) and Misiones — both WHO-identified endemic zones visited by Dutch index couple Jan–Mar 2026. Malbrán Institute rodent sampling teams mobilizing along full 4-month travel route.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: 30 passengers disembarked 24 Apr before outbreak confirmed, including 7 Britons. Index case body removed here; his wife (Case 2, PCR-confirmed) collapsed en route Johannesburg. Of the 7 UK nationals: 2 now self-isolating in UK, 4 remain in St Helena, 1 traced outside UK. St Helena authorities monitoring a small number of higher-risk contacts.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR-confirmed) died on arrival 26 Apr. Case 3 (British expedition guide Martin Anstee, 56, PCR-confirmed) in ICU after medevac from Ascension Island — condition improving, subsequently transferred to Netherlands. SA NICD contact-traced 65+ contacts from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight (82 pax + 6 crew).

sites.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN
sites.desc: Three evacuated patients now in Dutch hospitals: two confirmed cases at Radboud University Medical Centre (Nijmegen) and one suspected (41-year-old Dutch crew member evacuated 06 May). Ship's doctor (British, confirmed) rerouted to Netherlands after condition improved. One Dutch death (index case). KLM flight attendant tested NEGATIVE 08 May; WHO notes incubation still ongoing. GGD monitoring KL592 passengers.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed 2 British nationals PCR-positive (one treated Netherlands, one in South Africa). Two UK nationals who returned home independently self-isolating; FCDO/UKHSA Rapid Deployment Team pre-positioned at Tenerife. Asymptomatic British nationals from ship to be repatriated to UK and placed under 45-day isolation. FCDO consular support active across multiple countries.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending PCR results. French health ministry coordinating diagnostics and quarantine measures.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena, self-presented to doctor after symptom onset, confirmed Andes virus at University Hospital Zurich. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating. Swiss authorities conducting additional contact tracing.

sites.name: BERLIN
sites.desc: Third death: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/pneumonia onset 28 Apr). Cause of death under investigation — treated as suspected hantavirus; not yet officially confirmed. Evacuated patients being treated in Netherlands include individuals with links to Germany. RKI contact tracing active.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: 32-year-old woman hospitalized in negative-pressure isolation with cough and general malaise. Was seated two rows behind confirmed case on St Helena–Johannesburg flight; brief contact. PCR results pending. Valencia Regional Health coordinating contact tracing.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Ship arriving offshore 09 May — will NOT dock at Granadilla port following dockworker blockade threat and Canary Islands president's veto. Tender-boat evacuation to cordoned, isolated quayside area. Evacuation operations begin 11 May. Spanish nationals to Hospital Central de la Defensa Gómez Ulla (Madrid); others repatriated via charter. WHO/CDC/UKHSA/ECDC teams pre-positioned.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed suspected hantavirus case in a local islander — Hondius docked here 13–15 Apr. UK minister confirmed patient hospitalized on island; spouse isolating. Third British suspected case (separate from the 2 confirmed). UKHSA investigating; 4 islanders also traveled via Hondius to St Helena.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: Two male residents (aged 67 and 65) isolated in government facility; both disembarked Hondius at St Helena, flew via Johannesburg, and returned 02–07 May. One presenting mild rhinorrhea, second asymptomatic. Test results pending. CDA: public risk in Singapore low.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating — Hondius passengers who returned home. Four Canadians total remain aboard vessel awaiting Tenerife evacuation. PHAC coordinating monitoring.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadian Hondius disembarkees. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger under 42-day observation from departure date. Asymptomatic as of 07 May. CDC Level-3 response active. US State Dept arranging charter from Tenerife for 17 Americans still aboard to Nebraska National Quarantine Unit.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH monitoring returning Hondius passenger(s). Asymptomatic. Daily check-in protocol active. 17 Americans still aboard ship to transit Tenerife to Nebraska quarantine via State Dept charter.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring two residents who returned from Hondius. Both in good health with no signs of infection as of 07 May per DPH statement.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning Hondius passengers. Both asymptomatic.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring one returning Hondius passenger. Asymptomatic.

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NJ health authorities monitoring two individuals with potential post-disembarkation exposure to a Hondius passenger. Neither symptomatic.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: Nebraska Biocontainment Unit and National Quarantine Unit at UNMC staffed and ready. CDC and US State Dept arranging charter repatriation of 17 American Hondius passengers from Tenerife. Quarantine protocols on standby pending ship arrival and evacuation timeline.

sites.name: MANILA
sites.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius. Philippines DOH confirmed none are currently ill as of 05 May; in close coordination with vessel operator and international authorities. Monitoring continues pending Tenerife disembarkation.

sites.name: DUBLIN
sites.desc: ECDC TAB (06 May) confirmed Irish nationals among EU/EEA passengers aboard Hondius. Irish Dept of Health coordinating with ECDC and WHO on quarantine protocols for returning Irish nationals. Passengers to quarantine in Ireland per RTE reporting.
